description: Four channels of gain and level with a soft clipper on each, summed to one output, plus a link jack that joins the sum untouched

params.text: Sets the drive into that channel's clipper, multiplied by whatever the three-position switch beside it is set to
Sets how much of that channel reaches the mix
Picks how hard that channel's gain knob drives: unity at L, five times at M and a hundred times at H
Silences that channel; the module comes up with all four sounding

inputs.text: The audio into that channel, which is folded to a gentler slope beyond ±5V rather than clipped flat
Added straight into the mix with no gain, clipping or level of its own, for chaining another Moffenmix

outputs.text: The four channels and the link jack summed, clipped flat at ±5V
